Mod.Name: [Tsunamods] Card-RF
Mod.Author: Dulca & XHRIS & Hobbitdur & Ash & Slimebuck
Mod.Description: Card-RF is a graphical update to the beloved Triple Triad minigame! Which can now be played in full 60 FPS thanks to FFNx. Either using the vanilla upscale, or the Xylo option that use only original reference artworks from Final Fantasy 8 and higher, we have brought this amazing minigame to a more modern appearance

LatestVersion.ReleaseNotes: - 1.2: Fixed Card Menu Textures not working - 1.3: Adding language option - 1.4: New configuration options, languages and cards : - Vanilla enhanced cards - New boards (credits to Ash) - 1.5: New Vanilla enhanced option (credits to XHRIS and Slimebuck)
